name: Pic Macaya National Park
story: Pic Macaya National Park is located in Haiti within the southern peninsula and the Massif de la Hotte. Founded in 1984, it encompasses more than 8,000 hectares and reaches a height of 2,347 meters at Pic Macaya. It features the country's last stand of virgin cloud forest.
matters: The park belongs to the Massif de la Hotte mountain range and supports endangered plant and animal life, including species endemic to the island of Hispaniola.
